subject.title: fix(tts): validate maxLength is a positive finite number

question: Should the exported `setTtsMaxLength` writer reject invalid numbers, and if so what bounds and error contract are supported for existing plugin callers?
rationale: The current writer accepts a numeric value and is exposed through the TTS runtime surface; choosing a new rejection/error contract is an API compatibility decision rather than a mechanical cleanup.

options.title: Define and enforce a writer contract
options.body: Document the accepted range and error behavior, update the public types/tests, and land a narrow validation PR.

options.title: Keep the writer permissive
options.body: Retain the current writer behavior and validate only the user-facing command or configuration entry points that already define their own bounds.

recommendation.title: Define and enforce a writer contract
recommendation.body: Document the accepted range and error behavior, update the public types/tests, and land a narrow validation PR.
